text:
Marta: Quick sync — proposing a focused 2-week sprint to finalize the zero-trust connector + offline upgrade UX for Private deployments (VPC & air-gapped). Goal: ship installer + operator shim v2, <15m in-place upgrade for minor versions, and a documented fallback to relay. Need product + eng + field alignment.

Raj: Question: does <15m window assume tenant state size <= 2GB? For customers with large KV caches we may need staged cache warming. Also need clarity on egress IP preservation and whether we require BGP peering.

Devon: Agree. Draft acceptance criteria: 1) Successful in-place upgrade <15m for 95% of test tenants (state <= 2GB), 2) Automated canary with auto-rollback, 3) Manual rollback steps documented, 4) Fallback to relay when control-plane unreachable, 5) No change to customer egress IPs unless customer opts-in.

Samir: Field ask from AcmeCorp: must preserve egress IPs during cutover. Their infra team won't accept changing SNAT. We should add an "egress-preserve" mode to the installer that configures iptables rules + static NAT mapping and documents the network pre-reqs.

Elin: We already have a prototype egress shim. Needs tests for dual-stack, DNAT, and hosts behind NAT gateways. Also flag: KMS rotation during upgrade — ensure KMS handshake is non-blocking or has a failsafe to avoid pausing the rollout.

Marta: :thumbsup: Ops, can we get a rough eng + qa estimate so we can commit to the sprint?

Devon: Eng estimate: 2 devs x 8 days for shim polishing + integration tests, 1 QA x 6 days for canary harness + regressions, 3 infra days for packaging + airgap bundle. Total ~6 dev-weeks. Contingency: +2 days for unexpected egress edge-cases.

Elin: We'll also add a short runbook snippet to the README. Example commands for manual ops check:
```
# apply operator shim v2
kubectl -n redwood apply -f operator-shim-v2.yaml
# basic health probe
curl -sS http://localhost:9090/healthz
```

Samir: Customer comms rec: recommend a 2-week maintenance window with a 30m buffer for rollback. For customers that prohibit maintenance, offer staged canary + relay fallback and document the residual risks.

deploy-bot: nightly CI: operator-shim-v2 build passed on staging (2026-03-22T03:12Z) :white_check_mark:

Marta: Action items: @Devon write the acceptance criteria doc and link test harness; @Elin add egress-preserve tests + runbook; @Samir draft customer comms + optional maintenance SLAs. We'll do a quick review on Friday 09:30 PT.

Raj: One more ask: add observability hooks to Console — per-tenant upgrade latency, egress-ip-change events, and a small "upgrade health" metric to drive alerts.

Marta: Noted. I'll file dashboard ticket and tag EngInfra. Thanks everyone — let's aim to have the acceptance doc + rough test plan by EOD Wednesday.
